metaDescription: Order custom pink eye masks for your brand. Perfect for spa giveaways, wellness kits, and corporate gifts. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Pink custom eye masks bring a soft, calming aesthetic to wellness and spa giveaways. Whether you're assembling relaxation kits for employee appreciation or creating branded swag for a breast cancer awareness event, pink adds a gentle touch that stands out. Choose from plush hot/cold options for soothing relief or lightweight satin styles for travel comfort. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or heat transfer for a polished look that recipients will reach for again and again.
heroAltText: Custom pink eye masks with logo, plush fabric, and adjustable strap for spa and wellness branding
